title: Reconciliation and the Mystery: Christ in You
description: Paul explains to the Colossians that God has reconciled them, who were once enemies, through Christ's death, in order to present them holy and blameless. He reveals the mystery that was hidden from eternity but is now made known: Christ in you, the hope of glory. Paul rejoices over the sufferings he bears for the church and strives to present every person as perfect in Christ.
